kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.
